name: Horror Test World (throwaway world only)
notes: For proving Null and Stalkers actually run on your game version before they go anywhere near the survival world.
reminders: Run this on a brand new throwaway world, never the survival world.
Null's newest published file targets 26.20, so this is the test that tells you whether it still runs on your game.
Working? Null appears on its own after a while - do not use commands.
Nothing happening after ~20 minutes? Its scripts do not run on your version; leave it out of the main world.
